params.strategy: long-only SMA crossover (fast > slow), flat otherwise
params.signal_timing: signal from closes up to and including day t; position applies from t+1, filled at the close of t+1
params.cost_model: fee + slippage charged on the executed notional of every fill (entry and exit)

rounding: every *_pct and *_equity value is rounded to 2 decimals with Python's round()
notes: Price-only baseline on the committed BTC-USD daily candles; the node/mempool telemetry in data/btc_node_metrics.json has too few daily snapshots to be used as a backtest input. This is a measurement floor for future models, not trading advice and not a strategy recommendation.

diagnostics.win_rate_basis: share of round trips with positive net P&L after costs; a position open at the end counts as one round trip marked at the final close
diagnostics.num_trades_basis: fills executed (an entry or an exit each count; a completed round trip is two fills)
